# Exploding Kittens: Black Box (NSFW Edition) Rules
## Overview

The Black Box edition (officially "NSFW Edition") of Exploding Kittens is the adult-only version of the game. **The rules are identical to the Red Box (original edition)** — only the card artwork and flavor text have been replaced with adult-themed, provocative, and absurdist illustrations.

This is a standalone game for **2-5 players** (does not require the original Red Box). It can also be combined with the Red Box deck to support up to **9 players**.
## Game Objective

In Exploding Kittens: NSFW Edition, you are surviving the adult-art version of the same dangerous deck. Your goal is to avoid exploding kittens and be the last player still in the game.
## Red Box vs Black Box

![Same rules; Black Box is adult art; mix up to 9 players](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/red-vs-black.svg)
| | Red Box (Original) | Black Box (NSFW) |
|---|---|---|
| **Rules** | Standard | Identical |
| **Card count** | 56 | 56 |
| **Players** | 2-5 | 2-5 |
| **Art style** | Family-friendly | Adult / provocative |
| **Recommended age** | 7+ | 17+ |
| **Can combine** | Yes, up to 9 players | Yes, up to 9 players |
## Quick Rules Recap

![Drawing a kitten still needs a defuse](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/draw-or-explode.svg)
1. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-1 -->
   **Setup:** Remove all Exploding Kitten and Defuse cards. Deal 1 Defuse to each player + 7 random cards. Shuffle remaining Defuse cards and Exploding Kittens (one fewer than the number of players) back into the draw pile.

2. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-2 -->
   **On your turn:** Play as many cards as you want (or none), then **draw one card** to end your turn.

3. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-3 -->
   **If you draw an Exploding Kitten:** You must play a Defuse card or you're eliminated. If you defuse it, secretly place the Exploding Kitten back anywhere in the draw pile.

4. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-4 -->
   **Last player standing wins.**
## Card Types

| Card | Effect |
|------|--------|
| **Defuse** | Saves you from an Exploding Kitten |
| **Attack** | End your turn without drawing; next player takes 2 turns |
| **Skip** | End your turn without drawing a card |
| **Favor** | Force another player to give you a card of their choice |
| **Shuffle** | Shuffle the draw pile |
| **See the Future** | Privately view the top 3 cards of the draw pile |
| **Nope** | Cancel any action card played by another player (except Defuse and Exploding Kitten) |
| **Cat Cards** | Collect matching pairs/triples to steal cards from opponents |

> For the complete detailed rules, see the base **Exploding Kittens** (Red Box) rules page.

Jump directly to the rule topic you need.

- <!-- rule-item: flow-edition -->
  **Know the Black Box**

  Black Box is a standalone adult-art edition for two to five players. Its rules and card counts match the original Red Box; the two decks can combine for up to nine players.

  ![Same rules; Black Box is adult art; mix up to 9 players](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/red-vs-black.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Set up the deck](#flow-setup)
  - [Turn and explosion](#flow-turn)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **Deal Defuses first**

  Remove Exploding Kittens and Defuses. Deal one Defuse plus seven random cards to each player, then shuffle the remaining Defuses and one fewer Exploding Kitten than players into the draw pile.

  Related topics: 
  - [Take a turn](#flow-turn)
  - [Edition differences](#flow-edition)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **Play freely, then draw**

  On your turn, play any number of cards or none, then draw one to end your turn. Drawing an Exploding Kitten requires a Defuse; after defusing, secretly return it anywhere in the deck.

  ![Drawing a kitten still needs a defuse](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/draw-or-explode.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Win the game](#flow-win)
  - [Back to setup](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-win -->
  **Be the last player standing**

  A player without a Defuse when drawing an Exploding Kitten is eliminated. The final remaining player wins.

  Related topics: 
  - [Start another game](#flow-setup)

# 爆炸猫：黑盒版（NSFW Edition）规则
## 概述

黑盒版（官方名"NSFW Edition"）是爆炸猫的成人限定版本。**规则与红盒版（原版）完全相同**——仅将卡牌插画和风味文本替换为成人向、恶搞风格的荒诞插画。

这是一个独立游戏，支持 **2-5 人**游玩（不需要红盒原版）。也可以和红盒版混合，最多支持 **9 人**游玩。
## 游戏目标

在《爆炸猫：黑盒版》中，你在成人插画版的危险牌堆里求生。你的目标是避开爆炸猫，成为最后留在局内的人。
## 红盒 vs 黑盒

![规则相同；黑盒为成人插画；可混组最多 9 人](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/red-vs-black.svg)
| | 红盒（原版） | 黑盒（NSFW） |
|---|---|---|
| **规则** | 标准 | 完全一致 |
| **卡牌数量** | 56 张 | 56 张 |
| **玩家人数** | 2-5 人 | 2-5 人 |
| **画风** | 全年龄友好 | 成人向/恶搞 |
| **建议年龄** | 7+ | 17+ |
| **可混合** | 可以，最多 9 人 | 可以，最多 9 人 |
## 快速规则回顾

![抽到爆炸猫必须拆弹](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/draw-or-explode.svg)
1. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-1 -->
   **准备：** 取出所有爆炸猫牌和拆弹牌。每人发 1 张拆弹牌 + 7 张随机牌。将剩余拆弹牌和爆炸猫牌（比玩家人数少一张）洗入抽牌堆。

2. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-2 -->
   **你的回合：** 可以打出任意数量的手牌（或不出），然后**抽一张牌**结束回合。

3. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-3 -->
   **如果抽到爆炸猫：** 必须打出拆弹牌否则被淘汰。拆弹成功后，秘密地将爆炸猫放回抽牌堆的任意位置。

4. <!-- rule-item: quick-rules-recap-item-4 -->
   **最后存活的玩家获胜。**
## 卡牌类型

| 卡牌 | 效果 |
|------|------|
| **拆弹牌** | 从爆炸猫中拯救你 |
| **攻击牌** | 不抽牌结束回合；下一位玩家必须连续行动 2 次 |
| **跳过牌** | 不抽牌直接结束回合 |
| **索取牌** | 强制另一位玩家给你一张他选择的牌 |
| **洗牌牌** | 随机打乱抽牌堆 |
| **预见未来** | 偷看抽牌堆顶部 3 张牌 |
| **否决牌（Nope）** | 取消其他玩家打出的任何功能牌（拆弹牌和爆炸猫除外） |
| **猫咪牌** | 收集相同的对子/三条来偷取对手的牌 |

> 完整详细规则请参阅**爆炸猫**（红盒版）本体规则页面。
## 快速查阅
从这里快速跳到相关规则条目。

- <!-- rule-item: flow-edition -->
  **了解黑盒版**

  黑盒版是支持二至五人的成人插画独立版，规则和牌数与红盒原版相同；两副牌混用最多可支持九人。

  ![规则相同；黑盒为成人插画；可混组最多 9 人](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/red-vs-black.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [准备牌堆](#flow-setup)
  - [回合与爆炸](#flow-turn)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **先发拆弹牌**

  先取出爆炸猫和拆弹牌；每人发一张拆弹牌加七张随机牌，再将剩余拆弹牌和比玩家人数少一张的爆炸猫洗回牌堆。

  相关主题：
  - [进行回合](#flow-turn)
  - [版本差异](#flow-edition)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **自由出牌后抽一张**

  你的回合可以打任意数量的牌，也可以不打；随后抽一张结束回合。抽到爆炸猫必须用拆弹牌，并秘密把它放回牌堆任意位置。

  ![抽到爆炸猫必须拆弹](/images/rules/exploding-kittens-nsfw-edition/draw-or-explode.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [获胜条件](#flow-win)
  - [回到准备](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-win -->
  **成为最后存活者**

  抽到爆炸猫而没有拆弹牌的玩家淘汰；最后仍留在游戏中的玩家获胜。

  相关主题：
  - [再开一局](#flow-setup)
